name: Good Luck Charm
label: Quest
description: Good Luck Charm: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It would seem that I was wrong about you friend, and for that I owe you an apology. My sister sent me a number of personal effects, including humorously enough the deed to the Felstone farm. I think I'll pass on reclaiming it right now.
If my sister's spirit remains tethered to the farm and cannot rest, please... Could you return this to her? It is half of a good luck charm she had, with her husband having the other half.
Maybe her knowing I have these things will now put her soul to rest.

clips.title: Progress
paras: John, sweetheart... Is that you? I'm so cold all the sudden...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You give the half-charm back to the apparition. She looks at it, then at you expectantly.
"Honey, where did you put your half of the charm? We can't be together unless we have both halves. Honey... Can you see me?"
